Div: League division abbreviation (e.g., 'E0' for English Premier League)
FTHG: Full-Time Home Goals (goals scored by the home team)
FTAG: Full-Time Away Goals (goals scored by the away team)
FTR: Full-Time Result (H=Home win, D=Draw, A=Away win)
HTHG: Half-Time Home Goals (goals scored by the home team in the first half)
HTAG: Half-Time Away Goals (goals scored by the away team in the first half)
HTR: Half-Time Result (H=Home lead, D=Draw, A=Away lead at halftime)
HS: Home Shots (total shots attempted by the home team)
AS: Away Shots (total shots attempted by the away team)
HST: Home Shots on Target (shots on goal by the home team)
AST: Away Shots on Target (shots on goal by the away team)
HF: Home Fouls (fouls committed by the home team)
AF: Away Fouls (fouls committed by the away team)
HC: Home Corners (corner kicks awarded to the home team)
AC: Away Corners (corner kicks awarded to the away team)
HY: Home Yellow Cards (yellow cards given to the home team)
AY: Away Yellow Cards (yellow cards given to the away team)
HR: Home Red Cards (red cards given to the home team)
AR: Away Red Cards (red cards given to the away team)
Statistic: Type of statistic being recorded (e.g. HS, AS)
Count: Count of the statistic (e.g. number of shots, corners, etc.)
